description: For a function h from any type to a partial order, comparison of the images is antisymmetric exactly when h is injective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.induced_order_antisymmetric_iff.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PartialOrder β] (h : α → β) :
  (Std.Antisymm fun a b => h a ≤ h b) ↔ Function.Injective h
